## Wrong place?

This template is for a new skill or a change to a skill. For account, login, funding, platform, or order help, go to <https://ninjatrader.com/support/> instead.

## Workflow

Describe the workflow in plain English. Explain the trading task the skill should support and the steps it should take.

## Tools needed

List the MCP tools the skill would need to call. If a tool does not exist yet, describe what it would need to do.
